findings.description: The deposit() method allows any double value to be added to the balance, including negative numbers and NaN/infinity.
The balance member variable is not initialized in the constructor.
The class does not implement any form of authentication or access control.
Adding to balance could cause floating-point overflow or underflow.
If this class is used in a multithreaded context, race conditions could occur.
